title: Surface reclaimable worktrees at session start without spending a single git call
action: Decisions D4 and D4a. One scan function, called from exactly two places -- the same single-scan discipline unapplied_promote_proposals holds (status_full/mod.rs:219, whose comment says both callers call this ONE scan). Wire it into bee orient's blockers[] (orient.rs:217-255, following the promote-proposal push) and into a preamble block modeled on promote_proposal_lines (render.rs:306), invoked from budget.rs:573 with the same blank-line separator. THE LINE NAMES the count and `bee worktree prune --dry-run`. It does NOT name the reclaimable size, and it runs NO git subprocess -- read_dir and metadata only, the same cost shape as the promote-proposal scan. Count granted ids whose directory exists and whose grant is older than the threshold; show the line only above a threshold, since one stale worktree is not news. TWO CONSTRAINTS THE CELL MUST RESPECT, both measured in this repo: the preamble holds roughly 279 bytes of headroom against PREAMBLE_BUDGET_BYTES = 5120 (budget.rs:61, and budget.rs:50 records 11,390 bytes before the caps and 4,841 after), pinned by the_preamble_stays_inside_its_budget_however_big_the_store_gets (session_preamble/tests.rs:360) -- so keep the block to a heading plus one line; and this repo already lost the session-start git fight once, measured at status_full/records.rs:477 as bee orient 850ms with the git-candidate file versus 280ms with it emptied. There is no subprocess anywhere under hooks/session_preamble/ today; do not be the first.

truths: The preamble spawns no subprocess and the scan touches no git
The block appears only above the threshold and stays inside the byte budget
orient and the preamble read from the same single scan function
artifacts: A preamble test pinning the new heading text, beside the existing scribing-debt and promote-proposal pins
A test that the block is absent below the threshold
prohibitions: No git subprocess in the session-start path, for any reason
No directory-size walk in the session-start path
Do not duplicate the scan between orient and the preamble

trace.outcome: bee orient and the session preamble now surface a reclaimable-worktree count (grants file + one metadata() call per candidate, no git, no size walk) above a count of one, pointing at bee worktree prune --dry-run
